<DIV style="font-family: 'Times New Roman',Times,serif">
<P align="left" style="font-size: 10pt">The Registrant&#146;s registration statement on Form&nbsp;10, as filed with the Securities and Exchange
Commission on August&nbsp;18, 1999, and as amended on October&nbsp;18, 1999, November&nbsp;29, 1999, January&nbsp;19,
2000, May&nbsp;1, 2000, May&nbsp;26, 2000 and June&nbsp;16, 2000, is hereby amended to reflect the following
changes:


<!-- link2 "Item&nbsp;11. Description of Registrant&#146;s Securities to be Registered" -->

<P align="left" style="font-size: 10pt">Item&nbsp;11. Description of Registrant&#146;s Securities to be Registered


<P align="left" style="font-size: 10pt">On February&nbsp;23, 2005, the board of directors of Janus Capital Group Inc. (the &#147;Company&#148;)
amended the Rights Agreement, dated June&nbsp;14, 2000 (the &#147;Rights Agreement&#148;), between the Company
(formerly known as Stilwell Financial Inc.) and UMB Bank, N.A., as Rights Agent (the &#147;Rights
Agent&#148;), by adopting Amendment No.&nbsp;1 to the Rights Agreement (&#147;Amendment No.&nbsp;1&#148;). Amendment No.&nbsp;1
amends the definition of &#147;Acquiring Person&#148; contained in Section 1(a) of the Rights Agreement to
exclude certain categories of persons from the definition of &#147;Acquiring Person.&#148;


<P align="left" style="font-size: 10pt">The foregoing summary of the principal terms of the Amendment No.&nbsp;1 is a general description only
and is subject to the detailed terms and conditions of Amendment No.&nbsp;1, a copy of which is attached
as Exhibit&nbsp;4.2.3 to this Amendment No.&nbsp;7 to Form&nbsp;10
and incorporated herein by reference. Amendment No.&nbsp;1 was filed
with the Rights Agent on February&nbsp;24, 2005.
